import json

# Tri-state logic: True = provable, False = refuted, None = unknown (not derivable from givens)
def AND(*xs):
    if any(x is False for x in xs):
        return False
    if all(x is True for x in xs):
        return True
    return None

def NOT(x):
    return None if x is None else (not x)

# Givens (closed world: anything not stated is not provable)
ant_negotiates_stork = True
dalmatian_trades_stork = False        # "does not trade one of its pieces with the stork"
stork_money = 98
walrus_money = None                   # not given
mouse_location = "Nigeria"
AFRICA_COUNTRIES = {"Nigeria"}
mouse_in_africa = True if mouse_location in AFRICA_COUNTRIES else None
mouse_works_agriculture = None        # not given
mouse_hugs_dinosaur = None            # not given

# Rule1: ant negotiates with stork AND dalmatian does not trade with stork -> stork builds power plant
r1 = AND(ant_negotiates_stork, NOT(dalmatian_trades_stork))

# Rule3 (preferred over Rule1): stork has more money than walrus -> stork does NOT build
r3 = (stork_money > walrus_money) if walrus_money is not None else None
# A rule can defeat Rule1 only if it is provable; unknown Rule3 cannot defeat.
stork_builds_plant = (r1 is True) and (r3 is not True)

# Rule2: if some animal builds a power plant -> mouse does NOT shout at beetle
rule2_gives_not_shout = True if stork_builds_plant else None

# Rule7 (preferred over Rule4): mouse works in agriculture -> mouse does NOT smile at cobra
smiles_cobra = False if mouse_works_agriculture is True else (True if mouse_in_africa is True else None)

# Rule5 (preferred over Rule2): hugs dinosaur AND smiles at cobra -> shouts at beetle
r5 = AND(mouse_hugs_dinosaur, smiles_cobra)

if r5 is True:
    final = "proved"
elif rule2_gives_not_shout is True:
    final = "disproved"
else:
    final = "unknown"

print(json.dumps({
    "final_answer": final,
    "evidence": {
        "rule1_stork_builds_plant": stork_builds_plant,
        "rule3_blocks": r3,
        "rule2_mouse_not_shout": rule2_gives_not_shout,
        "mouse_smiles_cobra": smiles_cobra,
        "rule5_mouse_shouts": r5,
    }
}))
